TEST-OPA2 Dual, 1-MHz, Rail-to-Rail Output Operational Amplifier
1 Features
- Rail-to-rail output
- Unity-gain stable
- Supply range: 1.8 V to 5.5 V
2 Device Information
TEST-OPA2 SOIC (8) 4.90 mm x 3.91 mm
